basic_profile.bio: I'm a 38-year-old mother of two living in Seattle. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to spend quality time with my kids while pursuing my passion for art and design. I love exploring new technology, particularly in the design and creative fields. I generally dislike negativity and trolls online, and prefer engaging in constructive and positive discussions. My typical online hours are in the evenings after the kids are in bed. I'm happily married and enjoy spending weekends by the beach or exploring nature trails with my family.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Graphic Design from the University of Washington and have over a decade of experience in the field. I've always been fascinated by technology and design, which has led me to self-teach various software tools and stay updated with emerging trends. I have a keen interest in investing and financial planning, which I've developed through personal research and participation in investment communities.
